# Cncf Google Cloud Build Reviewer

Review Google Cloud Build using its official documentation and repository in the App Definition and Development / Continuous Integration &amp; Delivery category. Cloud Build lets you build software quickly across all languages. Get complete control over defining custom workflows for building, testing, and deploying across multiple environments such as VMs, serverless, Kubernetes, or Firebase.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
